title: Unit Event — A Light Drawn Closer — Episode5 A Warm Walk Home

meta.Event Outline: Mafuyu has been stuck unable to move forward since coming to stay with Kanade. Her father asks her what happened that day she spoke with her mother, but though she tries, Mafuyu finds herself unable to answer.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Alright, you're all free to go.
Please get home safe, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
They assigned us way too much homework today.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
I know, right?
I'm thinking about ditching club...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I need to tell Dad the next time he comes over...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(He's waiting for me to tell him.
He's waiting for me to come home.)

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Do you have club today, Mafuyu? I forget. If not, wanna work on these homework assignments together?

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
I know what you're up to.
You just want to copy her answers!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Huh? N-No, I dunno what you're talking about...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Oh, that's naughty.
It's important that you do your own homework.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know!
But let's still do these together! I'll make sure that my eyes don't wander!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Mafuyu!
Had a busy day?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I figured it was about time for your school to get out. So, I thought we could walk home together.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But you don't go to this school...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon, who cares about the details?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, how about it? Wanna walk with me?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You came all this way, so I suppose it'd be rude to say no...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. You're always so nice.
Anyway, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I decided to make some ribbons out of the rolls of fabric I bought at that shop for Rin and the others! And they turned out really cute!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna make you one too, so let me know which fabric you'd like me to use! They're honestly all really adorable♪

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You can choose since I probably won't have much of an opinion.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, in that case, you and Miku are gonna have a matching pair. I'm sure she'll really like that!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll let you know when I've drawn my design, so stay tuned♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you took a day off from working yesterday. How are you feeling? Better...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I feel much more at ease now...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But you don't just get over something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry. The thing is, Miku and the others told me about why you took yesterday off...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You want to tell your dad about what happened that night, but you're afraid to, right...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You came all this way to ask me that...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah. I know I'm being pretty nosy, but I wanted to talk to you about it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to tell him about what happened that night. I want to tell him how I really feel...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're afraid that he won't understand...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Especially since he's someone really important to you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: The thought of possibly being rejected after telling him everything is just so terrifying...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which makes you think, why bother telling him at all?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's probably why I became stuck for so long too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I'm starting to think that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There are more people who will accept me for who I am than I realized.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Now, I have a feeling that there'll be more people that'll say, “Thanks for telling me,” and, “No matter what, I'm on your side,” after breaking some big news to them...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I know you're scared.
Shaking that fear off isn't easy.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If you believe that there is even the slightest chance that your dad will understand... Then I think you two should talk...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ack, it's starting to rain! Talk about bad timing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I didn't bring an umbrella, so let's head home before we get drenched...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You're that way, right, Mafuyu?
Will you be okay on your own?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I told Mafuyu to do the very thing that I can't...)
